reply: didate reached a training NMSE of about 1.3e-4, which is still far from the 1e-12 target, so the structure is wrong. The best candidate was `c0 + c1·t^c2 + c3·x + c4·x² + c5·x³ + c6·v + c7·v·x + c8·exp(c9·t)`, and the data suggest a strongly nonlinear dependence on t and x that I could not pin down.
